name: flowspark
description_en:
FlowSpark is a broad AI-tool and enterprise-agent platform. Within that family, AI Meeting Note Taker turns pasted notes or uploaded meeting material into structured minutes with decisions and action items.

The meeting tool is not evidence that every enterprise automation claim or live conferencing integration applies to meeting capture. This profile distinguishes the specific notes workflow from the wider platform.
description_zh:
FlowSpark 是广义 AI 工具及企业 Agent 平台，其中 AI Meeting Note Taker 将粘贴笔记或上传会议材料整理为含决策和行动项的纪要。

会议工具不能证明所有企业自动化宣传或实时会议集成都适用于会议捕捉。本文区分具体笔记流程与更广平台。

core_features.explanation_zh: 生成草稿前按笔记选择会议结构。

core_features.explanation_en: Generate headings, decisions and proposed actions for review and export.
core_features.explanation_zh: 生成标题、决策和待核对行动项并导出。

sources.title: FlowSpark - AI Agent for Enterprise | Intelligent Workflow Automation Platform
sources.research_notes_en: Read real homepage #pricing section; text/image credit buckets and annual figures do not establish a meeting-minute rate.

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: The dedicated meeting page asks for a template and meeting content, then generates editable Markdown. Templates include project, decision, brainstorm and one-on-one formats. It describes extracting participants, discussion points, decisions and actions, with copying/export and history. The page also mentions recording upload, but exact file formats and maximum input length remain unanswered in the fetched FAQ.
sections.zh: 专门会议页要求选择模板并提供会议内容，再生成可编辑 Markdown。模板有项目、决策、头脑风暴和一对一等，介绍提取参与者、讨论、决策和行动，提供复制导出及历史。页面还提到上传录音，但抓取 FAQ 未给出具体格式及输入上限。

sections.title_en: Example: clean up a project standup
sections.en: Supply notes that clearly distinguish a proposal from an agreed decision, choose the project template and generate a draft. Compare each task owner and deadline with the input before exporting. If no owner was agreed, keep it unresolved rather than accepting a plausible generated name. The workflow organizes provided material; it cannot reconstruct an absent discussion. No generation was performed here.
sections.zh: 提供明确区分提案与已同意决策的笔记，选择项目模板并生成草稿。导出前按输入核对各任务负责人及期限。未约定负责人时，应保留待定，而非接受看似合理的生成姓名。该流程整理已有材料，不能恢复缺失讨论。本文未执行生成。

sections.title_en: Text and image credits do not define a meeting invoice
sections.title_zh: 文字和图片 credits 不能直接定义会议账单
sections.en: The homepage pricing section shows Lite/Pro/Max with separate monthly text and image credit allowances, while displaying annual prices and crossed-out figures together. It does not establish a per-minute meeting transcription rate or the credit charge for a notes generation. Leave a normalized meeting amount unknown. Confirm the selected billing cadence, input limits, tool entitlement, credit consumption and refund terms at checkout rather than equating image credits with meeting minutes.
sections.zh: 首页套餐区列 Lite/Pro/Max，每月文字及图片 credits 分开，同时显示年费和划线金额，但无法确定按分钟转录费或一次纪要生成消耗。因此会议标准金额保持未知，应在结账时确认周期、输入限制、工具权益、消耗和退款，不能把图片 credits 等同于会议分钟。

sections.title_en: Treat enterprise claims as separate evaluation work
sections.en: Begin with non-sensitive text and inspect the output before uploading recordings. The broader homepage advertises agents, private infrastructure and workspace integration, but the meeting page does not document those implementation paths. Do not present uptime, conversion or efficiency multipliers as measured results. Source licensing, retention, file security, live capture and operational deployment details remain unverified.
sections.zh: 先用非敏感文字检查输出，再考虑上传录音。更广首页宣传 Agent、私有基础设施和工作区集成，但会议页未说明这些实施链路。不能把在线率、转化或效率倍数写成实测结果。源码许可、保留、文件安全、实时捕捉及运营部署细节仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)

research_gaps.en: Verify meeting upload formats/length, generation credit charge, history retention and actual live-capture/integration behavior.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认会议上传格式时长、生成消耗、历史保留及实际实时捕捉集成行为。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
